bools.name: dlsSwordMeleeQuality
bools.comment: the sword and melee quality - the finest steel and razor sharpness, not magical, the +1 to hit only, worth the 2d6 times (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsBowQuality
bools.comment: the bow quality - perfectly balanced for pull and weight, each range treated as the next lowest, worth the 2d4 times (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsMissileQuality
bools.comment: the missile quality - balanced to fly true and strike hard, the +1 to hit only, worth the 2-5 times (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsMartialArtsQuality
bools.comment: the martial arts quality - made by masters, the +1 to hit only when used by those trained in a style, quite plain, worth the 2-5 times (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsNinjaQuality
bools.comment: the ninja quality - razor sharp and finely balanced, the +1 to damage, extremely lightweight and compact, the large weapons disassembling for concealment (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsPlusGrades
bools.comment: the plus grades - the +1, +2, +3 magical, the bonus to both the chance to hit and the damage (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsDamageBonusGrades
bools.comment: the damage grades - the +1, +2, +3 damage causing the extra damage but no bonus to hit (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsToHitBonusGrades
bools.comment: the to-hit grades - the +1, +2, +3 to hit increasing the chance to hit but not the damage (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsVsSmaller
bools.comment: the versus smaller - the +1 to hit and damage against man-sized and larger, the +2 against smaller than man-sized (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsVsLarger
bools.comment: the versus larger - the +1 to hit and damage against man-sized and smaller, the +2 against larger than man-sized (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsCursedUndetectable
bools.comment: the cursed concealment - undetectable from the normal +1 items, revealing the true nature only in earnest combat (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsCursedBowsReturn
bools.comment: the cursed bows - the -1 to hit, the to hit roll of 1 returning the missile full force on the firer for normal damage (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsCursedMeleePreference
bools.comment: the cursed melee - the -1 to hit, the owner preferring it to all others, never voluntarily discarding it, the remove curse freeing the character (print capture p. 294)

bools.name: dlsAccuracyAllShort
bools.comment: the accuracy - the +3 to hit and damage, all ranges considered short with no range modifier (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsBalanceSaveRegain
bools.comment: the balance - appearing the normal +1 and the +1 to hit and damage, the exceptional balance, the automatic save versus death to regain the footing (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsDancingWeapon
bools.comment: the dancing - appearing the +2 and the +2 to hit and damage, the command word after a preceding combat round, the weapon fighting the 2-5 rounds within the five feet, once every turn, the martial arts proficiency required (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsDetectionWeapon
bools.comment: the detection - the +1 to hit and damage, the d8 subtable of the detected thing, the hold and command word, the gentle tug (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsDisruptionPerDMG
bools.comment: the disruption - functioning identically to the mace of disruption of the DMG (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsDistanceDoubleRange
bools.comment: the distance - the +1 to hit and damage, firing to double all the normal range categories (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsFlameWeapon
bools.comment: the flame - the +1 to hit and damage, the command word bursting the magical flame, the 2d4 extra, the 40% ignition, the 15-foot light, the flame harmless to the weapon (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsIntelligenceWeapon
bools.comment: the intelligence - the +3 to hit and damage, the intelligence of the intelligent swords per the DMG, the semi-empathy the communication limit (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsSilenceWeapon
bools.comment: the silence - the +1 to hit and damage, the muffling field, the ninja 15% move silently and 20% hide improvements, the sonic attacks reduced, no protection against clumsiness (print capture p. 295)

bools.name: dlsSlayingWeapon
bools.comment: the slaying - the +3 weapon marked distinctively, the markings identifying the affected creature, the instant slaying on a successful hit, the missile losing all magic once successfully used (print capture p. 296)

bools.name: dlsSpeedWeapon
bools.comment: the speed - the +1 to hit and damage, the bows firing at the double rate and self-nocking, the first automatic shot, the complete surprise second-segment shot, the throwing weapons leaping and the automatic first attack (print capture p. 296)

bools.name: dlsUnbreakableWeapon
bools.comment: the unbreakable - treated as the +2 to hit and damage, not breakable by the Weapon Breaker, the 75% chance of breaking the opponent weapon instead (print capture p. 296)

bools.name: dlsVenomPerDMG
bools.comment: the venom - identical to the dagger of venom in the DMG (print capture p. 296)

bools.name: dlsRollTwice
bools.comment: the roll twice - the Table 79 grid instruction of the martial arts and ninja tails, rolling twice on the same grid (print capture p. 292)
